# Requirements — Cart

> Status: draft

## Requirements

### REQ-002 — Cart holds items

A shopper keeps picked items until checkout.

- Error: an item that is out of stock is refused.

### REQ-003 — Cart totals

A cart shows the sum of its items.

## Assumptions

- A-01 Assumption (needs validation): a cart total is shown in EUR only.

## Open Questions

- Which currencies must the cart total support? — recommended: EUR only, A-01 **Answer:** EUR and CHF
